propositions: Comment identity must shift from body-text equality to a persistent map of local HLC timestamp to Jira comment ID, preventing collisions and false re-syncs on edited text.

Outbound comment skip logic must prioritize the persistent ID map (primary guard), demoting body-equality to a secondary fallback, while inbound remains unchanged with jira_comment_id authoritative for its direction.

Returned add_comment IDs must be captured at both creation sites (create_one and update_one via _update_one_dispatch_comments) and immediately persisted via write-ahead record_comment_id save() for crash durability.

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-before-serialize ordering (fit text to limit, then JSON-encode for ADF), and the _resolve_codec injection must flip from IdentityCodec to the real codec for dedup convergence.
Comment sync must remain append-only in both directions—syncing comment creation once and skipping edits/deletes—and repeat reconcile passes must produce no duplicate comments.
